title: 3950. Exactly One Consecutive Set Bits Pair

examples.explanation: Binary representation of 6 is 110. There is exactly one adjacent pair of set bits ("11"). Thus, the answer is true.
Binary representation of 5 is 101. There is no adjacent pair of set bits. Thus, the answer is false.
